messages.description: List of messages to display in order. Each message is rendered by type (user → UserMessage, assistant → AssistantMessage).

initialLoading.description: When true, chat data is initially loading. The Skeleton component is shown in place of the message list until data is available.

thinking.description:
When true, shows the AssistantLoader below the message list to indicate the assistant is generating a response.
Fully controlled from outside — no internal logic derives this state.
